# Module Build Plan

Generated and maintained by `module-planner`.

## Build Principles

- Build in dependency order.
- One module per module-builder invocation.
- Frontend screens are owned by the frontend-screen workflow.
- A module cannot be marked complete until its required frontend screens and backend/integration work pass their quality gates.
